translation: If both the back of the hand and the palm of the hand are hard, congested, swollen, and hot and painful, one must correct the bone joints, and then there will be no later trouble. If one does not regulate and treat it promptly, the congested blood there will later transform into pus. For those with exuberant qi, take medicines for sores and toxins, and with regulation and treatment it may be cured; for those with deficient qi, it will in the future become a fistula (漏).
